scenes.text: Which 3D object looks like a ball? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is sphere. Great work!
Which solid looks like a tin can? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is cylinder. Great work!
Which solid has six square faces? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is cube. Great work!
Which solid has a circular base and one point? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is cone. Great work!
